sources: Flare 2.0 练后 专项补强 + Flare2 2026-11-21（Google 表 1aCseEk4vslsG-QKb-zsZwg30amvoYh5tMxzy6p9n8vA，练后专项补强：跪姿手腕俯卧撑）

purpose.zh: 跪姿撑地、手臂伸直，用手指把掌根抬起再慢慢放下，练手指和前臂，让手腕更能扛撑地动作
purpose.en: From a kneeling support with straight arms, press through the fingers to lift the heels of your palms, then lower slowly. Builds finger and forearm strength for hand-support moves.

text.zh: 手臂伸直，手指压地把掌根抬到指根
text.en: Arms straight, fingers press, palms lift

text.zh: 双膝着垫，膝、髋、肩一条线，手在肩下方，手指朝前。
text.en: Knees down, knees-hips-shoulders in one line, hands under the shoulders, fingers forward.

text.zh: 掌根抬到只剩手指贴地，手指根部不离开垫子。
text.en: Lift until only your fingers stay on the mat; the finger roots stay planted.

text.zh: 放下用 3 秒左右，掌根一点点贴回垫子；两只手同时做。
text.en: Take about 3 seconds to lower the palms back down; both hands together.

commonErrors.zh: 手肘弯了，用肩膀和手臂借力

commonErrors.en: Fingers lifting off, balancing on the fingertips.
Letting the palms drop back down.

cautions.zh: 手腕或手指关节刺疼就减小抬起高度
cautions.en: If your wrist or finger joints hurt sharply, lift less.

training.source: flare2 r3 animation tempo (5 s per rep: 1.0 s up, 0.5 s top, 3.0 s slow lower, 0.5 s pause); 表：按表慢速，草稿 10 次

flare2.item: 练后专项补强：跪姿手腕俯卧撑
flare2.camera: 侧前方（看得到锁肘、掌根抬起和手指贴地）；手部特写可看指根不动
flare2.doseBrief: 表：慢速若干次；草稿 10 次 1 组（次数待定）
flare2.note: Animation r3: kneeling plank, elbows locked, both palms tilt up about the finger roots by ~58 deg (fingers bent back, flat on the mat), 3 s lower. 10 s loop = 2 reps.

reminders.zh: 手臂一直伸直，手指根部贴住垫子
reminders.en: Arms stay straight, finger roots on the mat

reminders.zh: 掌根一点点贴回垫子，别砸下来
reminders.en: Palms settle down gently, never drop
